description: An outdoor snapshot from September 1937 showing four young women—Laverna Martin, Helen Williams, Alice Williams Howe, and Lois Minton—standing arm-in-arm in a grassy field. They wear vintage dresses and styled hair, reflecting late Great Depression-era American youth fashion and camaraderie.
